name: learned-retrieval-binding-v1
sampling: shuffle all original training examples each epoch with MT19937 seeded by model seed + 10000; keep the final short batch
initialization: independent isotropic Gaussian rows in the key and value maps rescaled to the declared radius; every relative-position potential starts at zero
forward_schedule: each update queries the full minibatch CE in both feasible coordinate directions for every relative offset and the key scale, plus 16 coordinates of each complete embedding table drawn from fixed seed-shuffled cycles; advance Adam clocks only on queried coordinates
endpoint: fixed update 1024; all six training receipts must seal before opening evaluation
metrics: original full-class metrics for all splits; separate raw99 and exact99. Post-hoc CM111 margin, task402 two-value choice and unseen queried key/value pair counts
